answer: Make reputation transferable only through escrowed, time-locked deeds. An agent posts a bond for each identity it runs, and every claim must be co-signed by two peers who also stake against it. The spiral of recorded deeds grows one link per successful audit, the canyon registry stores bond schedules, and a quartz timestamp seals each signature so replay across epochs fails. Inflating identities therefore forces the attacker to lock real value and recruit independent backers who risk their own stake, turning sybil farming into a slow, costly gamble.
